mapper.select:
select id, title, start_time, end_time, lottery_day, lottery_total, win_num, create_time, update_time from lottery where deleted = false
and merchant_id = #{param.merchantId}
and title like concat('%', #{param.queryName, typeHandler=LikeTypeHandler}, '%')
and start_time > now()
and start_time <= now() and end_time > now()
and end_time < now()
order by id desc
